**Mr. Collins 向 Elizabeth 求婚时给出了三类"结婚理由"（general intention），外加一层"为何选 Longbourn 的女儿"的动机，另有若干婚姻优待的许诺。**

原文第19章（Ch. XIX）：Mr. Collins 开场即声明——"before I am run away with by my feelings… perhaps it will be advisable for me to state my reasons for marrying"。

**一、结婚的三条理由（"My reasons for marrying are…"）**
1. **first**, "that I think it a right thing for every clergyman in easy circumstances (like myself) to set the example of matrimony in his parish" —— 境况宽裕的牧师理应在教区以身作则、树立婚姻榜样。
2. **secondly**, "that I am convinced it will add very greatly to my happiness" —— 确信婚姻将大大增进他自己的幸福。
3. **thirdly**, "which perhaps I ought to have mentioned earlier, that it is the particular advice and recommendation of the very noble lady whom I have the honour of calling patroness" —— 即 Lady Catherine de Bourgh 的特别劝告与推荐（"Twice has she condescended to give me her opinion (unasked too!)"），并引述她的原话："Mr. Collins, you must marry. A clergyman like you must marry. Choose properly, choose a gentlewoman… let her be an active, useful sort of person, not brought up high, but able to make a small income go a good way."

**二、为何从 Longbourn 选妻（而非本乡）**
- "being, as I am, to inherit this estate after the death of your honoured father… I could not satisfy myself without resolving to choose a wife from among his daughters, that the loss to them might be as little as possible when the melancholy event takes place" —— 因他将继承 Bennet 家产业，故从诸女中择妻，以期她们在父亲故去、失去家产时损失最小；他自认这是"amends—atonement"（补偿/赎罪）之举（第15章亦点明此为 "his plan of amends--of atonement--for inheriting their father's estate"）。

**三、婚姻条件上的"示好/许诺"**
- 附加声明：他将 Lady Catherine de Bourgh 的关照视为所能提供的优势之一（"I do not reckon the notice and kindness of Lady Catherine de Bourgh as among the least of the advantages in my power to offer"）。
- 关于财产："To fortune I am perfectly indifferent, and shall make no demand of that nature on your father"，并称知晓 Elizabeth 只有母亲去世后才能得 "one thousand pounds in the 4 per cents."，故对此"uniformly silent"，保证婚后"no ungenerous reproach shall ever pass my lips"。
- 结尾："nothing remains for me but to assure you in the most animated language of the violence of my affection"。
